reproduction_target: Single-cell CRISPRa/i screen analysis for the mapSPLiT platform in E. coli and P. putida: guide-barcode and sgRNA design (dna-barcodes tool, kinetic folding, Cas-OFFinder), STARsolo alignment of microSPLiT cDNA reads to custom references and count-matrix generation, Scanpy QC/normalization, GBC/sgRNA-based perturbation assignment, Wilcoxon differential expression, EcoCyc-based regulatory-network classification, bootstrap genetic-interaction scoring, GOATOOLS gene-set enrichment, and PCA/UMAP/leiden clustering of perturbation-induced cell states. Wet-lab work (plasmid/strain construction, microSPLiT protocol execution, GBC enrichment PCR, Cas9-based rRNA depletion, Illumina sequencing, D-lactate assay, plate-reader fluorescence, qRT-PCR) is out of computational-reproduction scope.
granularity_note: Coarse one-step-per-named-tool/analysis from the 'Computational methods' subsection of Methods. sgRNA design folds the custom target-selection rules, the Fontana et al. kinetic folding filter, and the Cas-OFFinder off-target screen into one step because they are described as one design pipeline. Perturbation assignment is a separate step because it is an author-defined procedure with no named tool. Experimental-methods procedures are counted in W and not verdicted. No code repository, script, notebook, command line, or configuration file is provided anywhere in the paper: the Data availability statement is entirely promissory ('will be made available on GitHub'), so there is no stage-2 artifact to read.

steps.label: Design of unique 12 nt guide barcodes with the dna-barcodes Python tool (v1.4.12), exactly 50% GC content; 316 nt GBC transcript layout (enrichment primer site, Illumina adapter site, poly-A, dCas12a filler) reported in table S2

sgRNA design: rule-based target selection (CRISPRi non-template strand within first 250 bp of ORF; CRISPRa +/-2 bp of 70/80/90 bp from TSS), kinetic folding filter of Fontana et al. (bind barrier < 10 kcal/mol, net energy < -25 kcal/mol), 12 random 50%-GC off-target controls from a custom Python script, off-target screen with RGEN Cas-OFFinder (< 5 mismatches removed)

Alignment of cDNA reads and count-matrix generation with STARsolo (v2.7.10a) against a custom reference (ASM584v2 for E. coli or ASM756v2 for P. putida, augmented with dCas9, MCP-SoxS, all sgRNA and all GBC transcript sequences), including read deduplication

Single-cell QC filtering, normalization, log-transformation and scaling with Scanpy (v1.9.3): transcript-count threshold from barcode-rank inflection point, removal of all rRNA/tRNA genes, second barcode-rank filtering, >3 genes per cell, >3 transcripts per gene (E. coli) or >5 (P. putida)

Perturbation assignment from GBC and/or sgRNA transcripts: assign each cell to the most highly captured matching transcript; ties labelled 'Multiple'; cells with no relevant transcript unassigned; multiple/unassigned cells filtered out

Differential gene expression with Wilcoxon rank sum test (tie correction) in Scanpy (v1.9.3): each on-target perturbation vs pooled matched off-target controls; DEG threshold p_adj < 0.05 and abs(log2FC) > 0.7; DEGs expressed in < 5% of cells removed; heatmap ordering by dendrogram

Gene regulatory network classification of DEGs as direct vs indirect connections using the EcoCyc database (plus previously published transcription-factor binding experiments for putative regulators); direction of change annotated as activation or repression

Genetic interaction analysis with a custom Python script: measured minus additive mean log2FC per DEG for combined vs single sgRNA perturbations; bootstrap resampling of cells with replacement over 1000 iterations; significance by 95% confidence interval not crossing 0; empirical p-value for mean transcripts per cell comparisons

Gene set enrichment analysis with the GOATOOLS Python package: up- and downregulated DEGs evaluated separately, GO terms filtered at p < 0.05 (two-sided Fisher's exact test), ranked by p-value, top 15 selected and iteratively filtered to remove parent GO terms of parent-child pairs

Single-cell clustering of perturbation-induced cell states in Scanpy (v1.9.3): restrict to stringent DEGs (p_adj < 0.05, abs(log2FC) > 1, > 5% of cells), PCA with 20 principal components (chosen from variance-ratio plateau of top 50 PCs), neighborhood graph with 10 neighbors, UMAP to 2D, leiden clustering at resolution 0.5, manual cluster annotation, perturbation enrichment threshold of 10% of cells or 1 SD above off-target percentage

headline.static_readiness: 0/10 (0%) - stage1 ceiling only, no R-star (R-star needs stage-2 code verification)
headline.inference_inclusive_upper_bound: All 10 computational steps cap at NI or below even under an inference-inclusive reading. The Data availability statement is entirely promissory: sequencing files 'will be deposited to the Sequence Read Archive (SRA) at the time of publication', processed data 'will be submitted to GEO at the time of publication', and analysis scripts 'will be made available on GitHub' - no accession, no repository URL, and no release exist at preprint time. The 8 steps that consume study-generated single-cell data are therefore X (data absent). The 2 design steps (C1 guide-barcode design, C2 sgRNA design) do not depend on the unreleased sequencing data and reach NI, blocked only by the absent custom scripts. Exact version pins exist for three tools (dna-barcodes v1.4.12, STARsolo v2.7.10a, Scanpy v1.9.3) with no environment closure, and Cas-OFFinder, GOATOOLS and EcoCyc are unversioned. There is no code artifact to read at stage-2; this paper cannot become R-star-eligible via a stage-2 code check.
headline.coverage: 10 computational steps assessed from the 'Computational methods' prose; 9 wet-lab steps counted (W) and out of computational-reproduction scope. No separate Code availability section exists; code and data availability are both covered by a single promissory Data availability paragraph.

gaps.missing: No SRA accession, no GEO accession, no BioProject. Data availability states only that sequencing files 'will be deposited to the Sequence Read Archive (SRA) at the time of publication' and processed data 'will be submitted to GEO at the time of publication'. Neither raw microSPLiT reads nor the processed cell-gene count matrices are obtainable.
gaps.how_to_close: Deposit raw reads to SRA and the processed cell-gene matrices plus per-cell perturbation assignments to GEO, and cite the accessions in the preprint rather than deferring to publication.

gaps.missing: No code repository, script, notebook, command line, or configuration file is provided. Data availability states only that 'Scripts used for data analysis and visualization will be made available on GitHub' - no URL, no organization/repository name, no commit, no release, no DOI. Steps explicitly built on unreleased custom code include the off-target spacer generator (C2), the perturbation-assignment procedure (C5) and the bootstrap genetic-interaction script (C8).
gaps.how_to_close: Publish the analysis repository (GitHub plus an archived Zenodo DOI) containing the STARsolo invocation, the Scanpy processing notebook, the perturbation-assignment code, the bootstrap genetic-interaction script and the GOATOOLS enrichment code, and cite it by URL and commit.

gaps.where: Software environment for all named tools
gaps.missing: No conda environment, lockfile, container image, or requirements file. Exact pins exist only for dna-barcodes v1.4.12, STARsolo v2.7.10a and Scanpy v1.9.3; Cas-OFFinder, the Fontana et al. kinetic folding implementation and GOATOOLS are unversioned, and the Python interpreter version is never stated.
gaps.how_to_close: Ship a pinned environment (conda-lock / pixi.lock or a container digest) covering the Python interpreter, Scanpy, STARsolo, GOATOOLS, Cas-OFFinder and the barcode-design tool.

gaps.where: C3 STARsolo invocation; C4 Scanpy filtering thresholds; C6 multiple-testing correction; C8/C10 stochastic components
gaps.missing: STARsolo command-line parameters (barcode geometry, UMI handling, deduplication mode, whitelist) are not given. The primary cell-transcript filter is described only as 'the inflection point of the cell barcode rank plot' with no numeric value per dataset. The method used to obtain p_adj from the Wilcoxon test is not stated. No random seeds are reported for the 1000-iteration bootstrap, the UMAP embedding, the leiden clustering or the random off-target spacer generation.
gaps.how_to_close: Report the exact STARsolo command line, the numeric filtering thresholds actually applied per dataset, the multiple-testing correction method, and the random seeds for all stochastic steps.

gaps.where: C3 custom reference genome; C7 EcoCyc database; C9 GO annotation source
gaps.missing: The custom reference (ASM584v2 or ASM756v2 augmented with dCas9, MCP-SoxS, all sgRNA and all GBC sequences) is not deposited as a FASTA/GTF artifact. EcoCyc is cited without a release version or access date. The GO annotation file and OBO release used by GOATOOLS are not identified.
gaps.how_to_close: Deposit the augmented reference FASTA/GTF alongside the code, and pin the EcoCyc release and the GO OBO/annotation file versions with access dates.
